newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak agency sells 67 pct in SCP paper - TASR.
newsitem.headline: Slovak agency sells 67 pct in SCP paper - TASR.

text.p: The Slovak National Property Fund on Friday approved the sale of a 67 percent stake it owns in the largest Slovak cellulose and paper producer Severoslovenske Celulozky a Papierne a.s. (SCP).
The sales was to a group called ECO-Invest a.s. Zvolen, the official TASR news agency reported.

TASR quoted a statement by the NPF, the state's privatisation agency, saying the price for the stake was 3.5 billion crowns. Neither company nor NPF officials were immediately available for further comment. Before the sale the NPF held a 100 percent stake in the company.
